title: Levelling and the Wanderer
summary: When he comes, and what he gives
lede: You never level up the moment you earn the XP. The Wanderer does it, and he only appears after a qualifying rest outdoors. Players often call him Lord British's ghost; this site uses the name in the Game Facts, the Wanderer. Here is every gate, in the order the game checks them.

blocks.text: The seven steps of a visit

items.title: Outdoors only.
items.text: A camp in a dungeon never qualifies.

items.title: 6 hours or more.
items.text: What counts is the number you chose, not the time you actually slept.

items.title: No ambush.
items.text: An ambush cancels the healing, the visit and the cooldown.

items.title: Cooldown has run out.
items.text: 14 hour changes since your last qualifying rest, counting the hours you just slept.

items.title: Healing.
items.text: Everyone except the guard, the poisoned and the dead gains 1 to 63 HP, up to their maximum. Mages and the Avatar get MP equal to INT; Bards get half their INT.

items.title: The visit roll.
items.text: 1 in 4. On a hit, he appears.

items: Every member who is not dead is restored to full HP and set to Good.
Each member's level is recalculated from their XP: 1 plus the number of binary digits in XP ÷ 100 (dropping fractions).
If the level differs from the one stored, it is updated and both HP values become 30 × level. One of STR, DEX or INT, picked at random, rises by 1, to at most 30.
A report is read out, chosen by your karma in bands of 20. The top band has its own Wanderer text.

blocks.text: The original gives **one** stat award per visit, even if you gained several levels at once.

blocks.label: Redux differs
blocks.text: You get one stat award for each level gained, and none when a level is corrected downward. See [Differences you'll notice](/redux/differences/#progress-0003).
The table of XP for each level is on [Levels and experience](/original/levels/).
